entailment_check.why: REVISED 2026-08-23. Was v4flash; the 2026-07-30 rationale below did not survive re-measurement. Same corpus, same classifier, same min_tokens=768 for every model (entail_probe_model.py). qwen3-coder-30b: raw recall 6/7, effective 6/7, ZERO false alarms on 15 controls, Youden's J = +0.857. v4flash today: raw 2/7, effective 3/7, 0/15 false alarms, J = +0.429. Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E (Q4_K_M) was also tried: 2/7, 0/15, J = +0.286. The decisive part is RAW vs EFFECTIVE. v4flash's documented 6/7 was 3 explicit verdicts plus 3 truncation nulls that news_digest.bad[] routes to repair; the old note predicted min_tokens=768 'should convert them to explicit verdicts', and it did -- into 'supported' on genuine fabrications. Giving v4flash room to finish made it WORSE (6/7 -> 3/7 effective), because the nulls were never judgement, only incompleteness that happened to fail safe. qwen3-coder-30b scores 6/7 with zero nulls: real verdicts, not artifacts. It is also ~15x faster (35 vs 2.4 tok/s), 21GB vs 103GB so it never pages on a 127GB box, and is already resident for every other local stage, so this removes a model swap from the run. Prompt was tested too and is NOT the lever: v0 (this prompt), v1 (adversarial prior) and v2 (per-claim decomposition) all tie at 6/7 with 0 false alarms; v3 (decomposition + mandatory source quotes) was worse at 5/7 with 1 false alarm. Keep the simplest prompt. NOT an OR-ensemble with qwen-finetune-q3: it says 'unsupported' on 82% of ALL cases (J = +0.06), taking false alarms 0/15 -> 12/15 for no recall gain -- noise, not a second opinion. A screen-then-adjudicate cascade was worked through and rejected on the same numbers: it yields v4flash's recall while letting anything the screen clears publish unexamined. case4 is the one miss for every model tried, and is borderline -- the summary says 'top-seeded team' where two headline-only sources say 'top the teams entered'. That is a paraphrase drifting more precise, not an invented fact, and the sources carry no article body. CAVEAT: n=7. Every gap here is 1-3 cases and the corpus is saturated (three prompts tie exactly). This is enough to reject the old rationale, not to rank two good options. fragment_merge deliberately stays on v4flash pending its own measurement.

snippet_writing.why: Routed local 2026-07-30. Its 100% score is only the snippet_flags usability gate (non-empty, terminal punctuation, no dangling attribution, no meta-commentary) and says nothing about prose quality -- but the earlier reason for keeping it metered ('the one stage a reader actually reads') rested on a premise the user never gave: there are no readers. With that withdrawn there is no measured reason to pay for it.

coherence_audit.why: agreement 80% (16/20). A disagreement reorders or retitles a section; it does not publish a false claim. $0.0768/run saved for a cosmetic risk.

exclusives_dedup.why: agreement 90% (18/20). Worst case is a duplicate story shown twice or one exclusive merged away -- visible, self-correcting, not a correctness failure.

fragment_merge.why: agreement 78% (7/9, smallest sample). Worst case is two fragments of one story listed separately. Only $0.0026/run, routed local mainly to keep the stage exercised against the local backend. Model switched to v4flash for fully-local: at min_tokens=768 it cleared this stage's one-word verdict cleanly, and it shares the batch with entailment_check so no extra llama-swap reload is paid.

_projection.basis: Per-stage cost apportioned from the last all-Claude run: 284 calls = $0.172 total, split by measured call share.

local.why: Zero metered spend. All five stages on llama-swap. Slowest wall-clock.

fast-snippets.why: Snippet prose on Claude, everything else local. Snippet_writing is the only stage whose output is read verbatim, and local scored 100% on the malformedness gate only -- so this buys prose quality, not correctness.

safe-verify.why: Entailment on Claude, everything else local. Buys back the ONE residual gap: v4flash has effective recall 6/7 = 86% (95% CI 50-98%) with zero false alarms on 15 supported controls, because a missing verdict routes to repair rather than publishing. The remaining miss (case4) is a fabrication both local models called supported. Use when a run's output must not carry a fabricated claim stamped verified.

fast.why: The pre-fully-local routing. Cheap high-volume stages stay local; the two stages where a local miss is visible in the output go to Claude.

claude.why: Everything metered. Fastest wall-clock, full cost. Escape hatch if llama-swap is down.
